basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Agentic AI Architect | Multi-Agent Systems for Dev Velocity | Cross-Language Codebases | Terraform / Docker / AWS
basics.summary: Agentic AI architect who ships the platform, not the feature. At LumApps I designed and deployed a production multi-agent system (Python, LangGraph, Google ADK, MCP servers I authored, LangSmith evals) that increased team velocity and eliminated manual toil across Sales and RevOps workflows. At Beekeeper I read, debugged, and improved codebases across Java, Python, TypeScript, Vue, and Hybrid Mobile (Android/iOS) apps, and led work spanning 3 teams. Open source: Terraform URL-shortener module (~4,600 users) on the Registry. Consulting mindset from Tenity (20+ startups advised) and Anand Creations, my Forward Deployed Engineering practice.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Architected and deployed a production multi-agent system for code and workflow automation across teams. Python + LangGraph + Google ADK, tools over MCP servers I authored, RAG grounded by a temporal knowledge graph. Increased velocity, eliminated manual toil, 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.

Route tasks between models based on cost and technical necessity: cheap models for classification, stronger models for reasoning and code understanding. Full cost-per-request instrumentation via LangSmith.

Interviewed teams (Sales, RevOps, Product) to identify repeatable manual pain points, then shipped standardised agentic solutions rather than one-off scripts. Same consulting motion this role requires.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Led work across 3 teams and read/reviewed codebases in Java, Python, TypeScript, Vue, and Hybrid Mobile (Android/iOS via Ionic/Cordova with Module Federation microfrontends). Cross-language technical breadth that translates to configuring AI checks across repos I did not write.

Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions CI/CD + OpenAI). Automation that eliminated manual toil for the product team; identical shape to the mandate here.
Ran K8s + AWS (including Lambda) production with Terraform IaC. Docker across the stack, observability via Grafana/Datadog/Logz.io, on-call.
Deputy tech lead of FUEL; acting hiring manager for AI roles. Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Built CI/CD and AWS infrastructure from scratch (Docker, Terraform, AWS Lambda). Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled Unilever partnership and a CES showcase.
Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs) end to end. Solo architecture decisions.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Consulting motion in practice: interviewed 20+ startups on architecture, listened for repeatable pain points, and translated them into scalable technical recommendations for seed-to-VC investors.
Active listener trained by real founders under time pressure.

Not feature dev: build AI automation tools that reduce manual toil, increase velocity, reduce bugs. Must handle multi-language codebases (PHP, TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin), AWS Lambda serverless, Terraform, Docker, CI/CD (Fastlane, Gradle). Consulting skillset critical.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong on agentic + AWS Lambda + Terraform + Docker + CI/CD + cross-language reading + consulting motion. Real gaps: no PHP/Swift/Kotlin/Fastlane hands-on. Beekeeper's Hybrid Mobile (Ionic/Cordova + Module Federation) is the closest signal for mobile CI/CD integration; called out explicitly. Java is Kotlin-adjacent (both JVM), noted. Positioned as an architect who reads codebases they did not write (JD says this explicitly). Consulting motion via Tenity + Anand Creations FDE.
